x: Gerry Warr walked exceptionally well and thoroughly deserved his second place in the handicap which was won by Bill Ferguson off the long mark of 9.30.
Scoring 20 a side, we won by 397 points to 423. A Club handicap held in conjunction resulted in a win by Bill Ferguson, 92.04 (17.45) with Bill Wesson, 94.04 (16.0) 2nd and R.
We had a good entry of 34 individuals but unfortunately we lost Eric Hall, Syd James, Norman Guilmant and Bill Ferguson and our first man home was Hugh McGreechan in 31st position.

It is with deep sorrow that we learn also of the death of Bill Ferguson at the early age of 44 years. Bill was a popular member of both Metropolitan Police and Belgrave walking teams, providing good sound backing to their many successes.
